_README: EVERY piece of shipping, delivery, guarantee, warehouse and countdown wording on the
site lives in this one file. Change a line here, run `python3 build.py`, and it changes
on the homepage AND on all 52 product landing pages at once - there is nowhere else to
edit it and nothing to keep in sync by hand.
These are the claims that get a store in trouble if they are wrong, so they are the
ones that must be trivial to correct when a supplier changes. Nothing here is enforced
by code: if you promise 24-hour dispatch, that promise is yours to keep.
The same wording exists on the Shopify side as theme settings, so you edit it in the
Shopify admin rather than in a file. See SETUP.md.
Anything you empty out disappears from the site rather than rendering as a blank gap.
Set a `show` flag to false to switch a whole block off.

faq: Yes. Every order placed before October 20th is guaranteed to land on your doorstep by October 30th, or we refund you in full and you keep the item.
Nothing. Shipping is free on every order in the continental US, with no minimum spend. Alaska, Hawaii and Canada are a flat $7.95.
Anything unopened can come back within 30 days for a full refund. If an item arrives damaged, send us a photo and we ship a replacement the same day - no return needed.
Do the light-up items come with batteries?

The rechargeable pieces - the hero masks, the under-cabinet bars and the pumpkin night light - arrive charged with a USB-C cable in the box. The battery-powered decorations take standard AA or AAA cells, which are not included.
Do you ship outside the US?
We ship to Canada, the UK, Ireland and Australia. Delivery runs 6-10 days, so international orders should go in before October 15th.
